findings.quote: Zoho Invoice: "$0 per month; the pricing page lists it as a forever-free invoicing plan ... Includes quotes, recurring invoices, ... and up to two organizations." and "Zoho Invoice costs $0 for the same 12 clients."
findings.problem: Zoho's pricing-page FAQ states limits the page omits: up to two users, a maximum of three projects, up to 500 invoices per year, and "Powered by Zoho Invoice" branding. Table row and section present the plan as unrestricted in a cost comparison against paid plans.
findings.fix: Add the limits (2 users, 3 projects, 500 invoices per year, Zoho branding) to the table cell and the Zoho Invoice section.

findings.quote: Standard ... adds bank feeds, progress invoicing, sales tax tracking and API access.
findings.problem: Acronym API used without definition on first use in the Zoho Books section.
findings.fix: Write 'application programming interface (API)' or drop the term.
